documents.title: Rolling infrastructure rebuild — the old infrastructure builds the new
documents.summary: Rebuild service by service using the running homelab to provision its replacement; no big-bang rebuild, no full hardware duplication.

documents.title: pve-management is a standalone bootstrap, orchestration and recovery host
documents.summary: The fresh Proxmox host pve-management stays outside the compute cluster and runs only management VMs (IaC toolchain, runner, later Windmill/Phase).
headings: ADR-002: pve-management as a standalone host

documents.title: OpenTofu for new infrastructure roots; legacy Terraform roots migrate individually
documents.summary: New roots use OpenTofu with bpg/proxmox; existing Terraform roots keep Terraform until each is migrated with a verified no-change plan.

documents.title: Phase for runtime secrets, SOPS + age for bootstrap and recovery secrets
documents.summary: Phase is the confirmed Infisical replacement (deployment gated on validating its self-hosted free edition); SOPS+age protects bootstrap material so recovery never needs Phase, Forgejo or Windmill.
headings: ADR-004: Secrets — Phase at runtime, SOPS + age for bootstrap

documents.title: Windmill is the operations UI over a versioned service catalog
documents.summary: Each service declares a service.yaml catalog entry whose input schema drives a Windmill form; Windmill triggers versioned workflows and never replaces OpenTofu, Ansible or Forgejo.
headings: ADR-005: Windmill over a versioned service catalog

documents.title: Docker Compose first; k3s and Argo CD later, only where they add value
documents.summary: Applications run as Compose projects on VMs; k3s with Argo CD is a future option. Supersedes the legacy K3s/Flux-first direction.

documents.title: Archive the legacy Codex workflow; keep live legacy IaC roots in place until migrated
documents.summary: Old AGENTS.md, roadmap, tasks and docs moved verbatim to docs/archive/codex-2026; legacy Terraform/Ansible code that still manages live resources stays at its path.
headings: ADR-007: Archive the legacy workflow, keep live roots

documents.title: Bootstrap runs from the operator workstation; CT301 stays validation-only
documents.summary: The first OpenTofu applies on pve-management run from the workstation through approval-gated Make targets; CT301 never holds Proxmox credentials nor applies; a trusted runner comes later.

documents.title: The management VM is the operator's GNOME admin workstation
documents.summary: mgmt-control-01 is a GNOME admin workstation (Ubuntu 26.04, 8 vCPU host type, 10 GiB, 120 GiB) with RDP remote login, the IaC toolchain, Claude Code and Codex.
headings: ADR-009: Management VM as a GNOME admin workstation

documents.title: The new Proxmox cluster is founded on pve-management and grows with reclaimed hosts
documents.summary: pve-management founds the new Proxmox cluster; the emptied pve-core joins first, every reclaimed host follows by the same repeatable process. Supersedes ADR-002.
headings: ADR-010: New Proxmox cluster founded on pve-management

documents.title: k3s is the application platform from the start, reconciled by Argo CD and administered with Headlamp
documents.summary: New applications run on k3s (OpenTofu VMs, Ansible bootstrap, embedded etcd); Argo CD reconciles them from Forgejo; Headlamp is the Kubernetes UI; Windmill automates workflows. Supersedes ADR-006.
headings: ADR-011: k3s first, Argo CD for GitOps, Headlamp for administration

documents.title: Kubernetes persistent data lives on NVMe-backed storage outside k3s; TrueNAS is the backup destination; Ceph later
documents.summary: PVCs come through CSI from NVMe-backed storage outside k3s on the physical hosts; TrueNAS only receives backups; Ceph (RBD, CephFS) is the future distributed layer.
headings: ADR-012: External NVMe-backed Kubernetes storage, TrueNAS for backups, Ceph later

documents.title: A central PostgreSQL platform with Patroni replication serves the applications
documents.summary: Applications get their own database, role and credentials on a shared PostgreSQL platform managed by Patroni (Zalando Postgres Operator pending validation), on external NVMe-backed PVCs.

documents.title: A dedicated Forgejo runner VM executes approved infrastructure workflows
documents.summary: A runner VM created with OpenTofu and configured with Ansible runs approved OpenTofu, Ansible, k3s and Helm jobs with scoped credentials; CT301 stays validation-only. Amends ADR-008.

documents.title: Target homelab platform architecture
documents.summary: Layers and owners of the rebuilt homelab: Proxmox cluster, k3s, Headlamp, external NVMe storage via CSI, PostgreSQL/Patroni, Phase, Argo CD, Windmill, runner; TrueNAS for backups.

documents.title: homelab-iac — project vision and overview
documents.summary: Authoritative vision, rolling-rebuild strategy, target stack and roadmap M000-M012, current status, confirmed decisions vs pending technical choices; read first.

documents.title: Current handoff and next steps
documents.summary: Read first in a new session: what exists, where the state lives, how to work from mgmt-control-01, the current and next task.
headings: First steps in the first Ubuntu session

documents.title: Legacy homelab inventory (archived repository, operator corrections, state review)
documents.summary: Legacy hosts, guests, services and local Terraform states, with retired hosts, stale state and endpoint hazards; starting point for the M000 live inventory.
headings: Local Terraform state (verified on the operator workstation, 2026-11-12)
New cluster reuses names and addresses (2026-11-16)

documents.title: New Proxmox cluster inventory
documents.summary: Authoritative read-only audit of the new doku-lab cluster (pve-management, pve-core, pve-infra, new pve-lab .16): membership, hardware, NVMe, network, guests, capacity, placement.
headings: Storage options for M006 (input, not a decision)

documents.title: pve-management bootstrap — readiness and implementation plan
documents.summary: Readiness, exact API privileges, SSH/TLS/state decisions, proposed VM values and the next step for provisioning mgmt-control-01 on pve-management; nothing applied.
headings: pve-management bootstrap — readiness and implementation plan
Proxmox API privileges (exact, from the PVE API schema)

documents.title: Infrastructure inventory and migration planning
documents.summary: Accurate live inventory of hosts, guests, services, data and backups, and a migration order that avoids unnecessary downtime.
headings: M000 — Infrastructure inventory and migration planning

documents.title: Management workstation
documents.summary: Existing infrastructure provisions and configures the management workstation VM on pve-management from IaC, and operations move to it.

documents.title: New Proxmox cluster (four nodes)
documents.summary: The new cluster doku-lab runs on pve-management, pve-core, pve-infra and the new pve-lab (.16), quorate, with its hardware and capacity inventoried.

documents.title: Dedicated Forgejo deployment runner
documents.summary: A dedicated runner VM, built with OpenTofu and Ansible, executes approved infrastructure workflows from the existing Forgejo with scoped credentials.

documents.title: k3s bootstrap
documents.summary: The first k3s cluster (one or more VMs, embedded etcd) is provisioned with OpenTofu, configured with Ansible and reachable with kubectl.

documents.title: Headlamp
documents.summary: Headlamp is deployed with its official Helm chart, RBAC-based authentication and network restriction, and shows nodes, workloads, storage objects, events and logs.

documents.title: External NVMe-backed storage
documents.summary: Kubernetes provisions PVCs through CSI from an NVMe-backed storage service outside k3s; data survives pod and k3s VM replacement; the failure domain is documented.

documents.title: PostgreSQL platform
documents.summary: The selected PostgreSQL operator runs a Patroni-managed primary on external NVMe-backed storage, with per-application databases and roles.

documents.title: Phase
documents.summary: Phase runs on k3s with its supported database and storage, issues service identities, and new deployments read their secrets from it.

documents.title: Argo CD and Windmill
documents.summary: Argo CD reconciles Kubernetes applications from Forgejo and Windmill runs operational workflows integrated with the repository and the runner.

documents.title: Rolling application migration
documents.summary: Applications move one at a time to k3s with their data, secrets and databases, are validated, cut over, and the old workloads retired; freed hosts join the cluster.

documents.title: Ceph and infrastructure expansion
documents.summary: With enough hosts and NVMe devices, Ceph (RBD, CephFS) provides distributed storage through CSI, selected PVCs migrate to it and PostgreSQL replicas spread across hosts.

documents.title: Backups and finalization
documents.summary: Persistent data is inventoried and backed up to TrueNAS with tested, database-aware restores, and the obsolete infrastructure is retired.

documents.title: Reset repository to the agent harness and record the rebuild direction
documents.summary: Install the agent harness, archive the legacy Codex workflow, and document vision, architecture, decisions and roadmap.
headings: TASK-001 — Reset repository to the agent harness and record the rebuild direction

documents.title: Live read-only inventory of Proxmox hosts, guests and storage
documents.summary: Verify hosts, cluster membership, VMs/LXCs, storage and capacity on every node; correct the legacy inventory.
headings: TASK-002 — Live read-only inventory of Proxmox hosts, guests and storage

documents.title: Service dependency, network/DNS and data/backup map
documents.summary: Map every service's dependencies (DNS, proxy, auth, secrets, storage), its persistent data and its backup coverage.
headings: TASK-003 — Service dependency, network/DNS and data/backup map

documents.title: Representative PBS restore test
documents.summary: Restore one representative guest backup from PBS to an isolated, disposable target and verify it boots and holds its data.

documents.title: Migration order and bootstrap credential requirements
documents.summary: Decide the service migration order and list every bootstrap credential and recovery prerequisite.
headings: TASK-005 — Migration order and bootstrap credential requirements

documents.title: Target repository layout, OpenTofu toolchain and management Make targets
documents.summary: Keep the terraform/ tree, pin OpenTofu 1.13.9 for new roots, add guarded mgmt-* Make targets and offline CI validation (make mgmt-check).
headings: TASK-006 — Target repository layout, OpenTofu toolchain and management Make targets

documents.title: Scoped Proxmox API token and SSH access for pve-management
documents.summary: Define and verify the dedicated automation identity, role and token on pve-management, and SSH access for Ansible.
headings: TASK-007 — Scoped Proxmox API token and SSH access for pve-management

documents.title: Reusable OpenTofu guest module and management VM root
documents.summary: Write modules/opentofu/proxmox-guest (bpg/proxmox, cloud-init) and the stacks/management root that creates the Ubuntu management VM.
headings: TASK-008 — Reusable OpenTofu guest module and management VM root

documents.title: Ansible baseline for the management VM (toolchain and runner)
documents.summary: Configure the management VM with Ansible: SSH hardening, guest agent, OpenTofu, Ansible environment, SOPS/age. No runner in M001 (ADR-008).
headings: TASK-009 — Ansible baseline for the management VM (toolchain and runner)

documents.title: OpenTofu state: one local authority, handed over to the workstation
documents.summary: Keep new-root state local on the single operator workstation, move it from the Mac to mgmt-control-01, and never let an empty state recreate existing guests.
headings: TASK-010 — OpenTofu state management and backups

documents.title: SOPS + age bootstrap secrets
documents.summary: Introduce .sops.yaml, an encrypted secrets/bootstrap/ file for the Proxmox token and SSH material, and decryption in Ansible/OpenTofu workflows.

documents.title: Independent bootstrap and recovery runbook
documents.summary: Write and exercise the runbook that rebuilds the management VM from a clean workstation.
headings: TASK-012 — Independent bootstrap and recovery runbook

documents.title: Reinstall pve-core and form the new Proxmox cluster
documents.summary: Confirm the emptied pve-core holds nothing to keep, inventory its NVMe, reinstall Proxmox VE, create the cluster on pve-management and join pve-core with an explicit two-node quorum plan.
headings: TASK-013 — Reinstall pve-core and form the new Proxmox cluster

documents.title: Bootstrap deployment runner VM on pve-core
documents.summary: Runner VM deploy-runner-01 (VMID 302, .32) on pve-core via headless-vm, deploy_runner role, main-only wrapper, approval-gated dispatch workflow and a disposable proof root (ADR-014).
headings: TASK-014 — Bootstrap deployment runner VM on pve-core
